mapper.update: UPDATE material_content_blob SET detected_mime = #{detectedMime}, original_object_key = #{originalObjectKey}, original_object_version_id = NULL, s3_etag = NULL, s3_checksum_sha256 = NULL, status = 'PROMOTING' WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND status = 'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS material_id, v.id AS version_id, r.id AS revision_id, v.content_blob_id AS content_blob_id, m.lifecycle_generation AS material_lifecycle_generation FROM material_version v JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.version_id = v.id WHERE m.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND v.content_blob_id = #{contentBlobId} AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND r.revision_no = (SELECT MAX(r2.revision_no) FROM material_processing_revision r2 WHERE r2.version_id = v.id) ORDER BY v.created_at ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.id AS material_id, v.id AS version_id, r.id AS revision_id, v.content_blob_id AS content_blob_id, m.lifecycle_generation AS material_lifecycle_generation FROM material m JOIN material_version v ON v.material_id = m.id JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.version_id = v.id WHERE m.id = #{materialId} AND m.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND v.content_blob_id = #{contentBlobId} AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND r.revision_no = (SELECT MAX(r2.revision_no) FROM material_processing_revision r2 WHERE r2.version_id = v.id) LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

UPDATE material_upload_session u SET material_id = #{materialId}, version_id = #{versionId}, content_blob_id = #{contentBlobId}, processing_revision_id = #{revisionId}, material_lifecycle_generation = #{materialLifecycleGeneration}, state = 'SUCCEEDED', completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), generation = generation + 1 WHERE u.id = #{uploadId} AND u.state = 'PROCESSING' AND u.security_status = 'VALIDATED' AND u.generation = #{expectedGeneration} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_processing_job j WHERE j.id = #{jobId} AND j.upload_session_id = u.id AND j.stage = 'RESOLVE_CONTENT_DEDUP' AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS upload_id, u.generation AS upload_generation, u.quarantine_bucket, u.quarantine_key, u.quarantine_object_version_id AS quarantine_version_id, b.original_object_key AS destination_key, b.id AS content_blob_id, u.material_id, u.version_id, u.processing_revision_id AS revision_id, b.detected_mime AS detected_media_type, b.byte_size, b.content_sha256, r.fingerprint AS processing_fingerprint, b.original_object_version_id AS formal_object_version_id, b.s3_etag AS formal_etag, b.s3_checksum_sha256 AS formal_checksum_sha256 FROM material_upload_session u JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.id = #{jobId} AND j.upload_session_id = u.id AND j.stage = 'PROMOTE_ORIGINAL' AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) JOIN material_content_blob b ON b.id = u.content_blob_id AND b.owner_type = u.owner_type AND b.owner_key = u.owner_key JOIN material m ON m.id = u.material_id AND m.owner_type = u.owner_type AND m.owner_key = u.owner_key AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND m.lifecycle_generation = u.material_lifecycle_generation AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = u.processing_revision_id AND r.version_id = u.version_id AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' WHERE u.id = #{uploadId} AND u.state = 'PROCESSING' AND u.security_status = 'VALIDATED' AND b.status IN ('PROMOTING', 'AVAILABLE')
mapper.update: UPDATE material_content_blob b SET original_object_key = #{objectKey}, original_object_version_id = #{objectVersionId}, s3_etag = #{eTag}, s3_checksum_sha256 = #{checksumSha256}, status = 'AVAILABLE', promoted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE b.id = #{contentBlobId} AND b.status = 'PROMOTING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_upload_session u JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.id = #{jobId} AND j.upload_session_id = u.id AND j.stage = 'PROMOTE_ORIGINAL' JOIN material m ON m.id = u.material_id AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND m.lifecycle_generation = u.material_lifecycle_generation AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = u.processing_revision_id AND r.version_id = u.version_id AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' WHERE u.id = #{uploadId} AND u.content_blob_id = b.id AND u.state = 'PROCESSING' AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_upload_session u JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.id = #{jobId} AND j.upload_session_id = u.id AND j.stage = 'PROMOTE_ORIGINAL' AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) JOIN material_content_blob b ON b.id = u.content_blob_id AND b.id = #{contentBlobId} AND b.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND b.original_object_key = #{objectKey} AND b.original_object_version_id = #{objectVersionId} AND b.s3_checksum_sha256 = #{checksumSha256} JOIN material m ON m.id = u.material_id AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND m.lifecycle_generation = u.material_lifecycle_generation AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = u.processing_revision_id AND r.version_id = u.version_id AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' WHERE u.id = #{uploadId} AND u.state = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.update: UPDATE material_version v SET ingest_state = 'PROCESSING' WHERE v.id = #{versionId} AND v.ingest_state = 'PROMOTING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_upload_session u JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.id = #{jobId} AND j.upload_session_id = u.id AND j.stage = 'PROMOTE_ORIGINAL' JOIN material m ON m.id = u.material_id AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND m.lifecycle_generation = u.material_lifecycle_generation AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = u.processing_revision_id AND r.version_id = v.id AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' WHERE u.id = #{uploadId} AND u.version_id = v.id AND u.state = 'PROCESSING' AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_upload_session u JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.id = #{jobId} AND j.upload_session_id = u.id AND j.stage = 'PROMOTE_ORIGINAL' AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) JOIN material m ON m.id = u.material_id AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND m.lifecycle_generation = u.material_lifecycle_generation AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) JOIN material_version v ON v.id = u.version_id AND v.id = #{versionId} AND v.material_id = m.id AND v.ingest_state = 'PROCESSING' JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = u.processing_revision_id AND r.id = #{revisionId} AND r.version_id = v.id AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' WHERE u.id = #{uploadId} AND u.state = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.update: UPDATE material_upload_session u SET state = 'SUCCEEDED', completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), generation = generation + 1 WHERE u.id = #{uploadId} AND u.state = 'PROCESSING' AND u.security_status = 'VALIDATED' AND u.generation = #{expectedGeneration} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_processing_job j JOIN material m ON m.id = u.material_id AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND m.lifecycle_generation = u.material_lifecycle_generation AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = u.processing_revision_id AND r.version_id = u.version_id AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' JOIN material_content_blob b ON b.id = u.content_blob_id AND b.status = 'AVAILABLE' WHERE j.id = #{jobId} AND j.upload_session_id = u.id AND j.stage = 'PROMOTE_ORIGINAL' AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
